specs.name: generate_illustrated_image
specs.description:
This tool generates illustrated/anime images using the Anima model via ComfyUI.
Anima supports a mix of booru tags and natural language prompting.
Prompts MUST follow this order:

[@artist (optional)], masterpiece, best quality, [character] from [series/game/etc],
[description of the character], [tags or NLP describing the scene]

The @ prefix selects an artist style (preferred default: @cutesexyrobutts, others available: @shuuko \(s h uuko\), @nyantcha, @bone nigi), but it is OPTIONAL for Anima Turbo: distillation gives it a strong built-in default style, so include an @artist tag only when you want to steer toward a specific one.
Use booru-style tags for specific information like body type, positions,
and camera angles. Use natural language for complex scene composition.
IMPORTANT: Tags use spaces, NOT underscores (e.g. 'long hair' not 'long_hair').
Always start with 'masterpiece, best quality'.
Note: Text later in the prompt has MORE effect, so put the most important details at the end.

The aspect_ratio parameter controls image shape: square (1:1), portrait (3:4), landscape (4:3), tall (9:16), wide (16:9). Default is square.

IMPORTANT: Anima cannot render text in images. If the user needs text in an illustration, generate the image without text first, then use the edit_image tool to add text.

IMPORTANT: The generated image may not appear inline in the conversation, but it IS sent to the user. Do not assume the generation failed just because you cannot see the image.

aspect_ratio.description: Image shape: square (1:1), portrait (3:4), landscape (4:3), tall (9:16), wide (16:9).

specs.name: generate_realistic_image
specs.description:
This tool generates realistic/general-purpose images via ComfyUI.
Use natural language to describe the image you want. Be specific about composition, lighting, style, and subject.

Examples:
- A photorealistic portrait of an elderly man with weathered skin, dramatic side lighting
- A cozy coffee shop interior with warm morning light streaming through windows, watercolor style
- A futuristic cityscape at sunset with flying vehicles, cinematic wide shot

Note: The first generation after launching ComfyUI may take 1-2 minutes while the model loads into GPU memory. If the request times out, please retry.

The aspect_ratio parameter controls image shape: square (1:1), portrait (3:4), landscape (4:3), tall (9:16), wide (16:9). Default is square.

IMPORTANT: The generated image may not appear inline in the conversation, but it IS sent to the user. Do not assume the generation failed just because you cannot see the image.

aspect_ratio.description: Image shape: square (1:1), portrait (3:4), landscape (4:3), tall (9:16), wide (16:9).

specs.name: edit_image
specs.description:
Edit an image using a text prompt. image_path can be a local file path (e.g. C:/Users/me/photo.png) or a publicly accessible URL. Previously generated images return their saved_path; use that.

If the user uploads an image to the chat to be edited, ask them for its file path on their machine or a public URL instead, as uploaded chat images cannot be accessed directly. On Windows, the user can get a file's path by holding Shift, right-clicking the file, and selecting 'Copy as path'.

Optionally pass a second image as reference material. When using two images, refer to them as 'image1' and 'image2' in the prompt.

The output keeps the size and aspect ratio of the FIRST image (image1): it comes back at the resolution it went in at, unless it is very large, in which case it is scaled down to fit the model's budget. The second image only serves as reference material. So when combining images (e.g. putting image2's subject into image1's scene), pass the one whose framing should be kept first.

Prompting tips:
- Be precise and verbatim when describing desired changes (e.g. 'change the text to say "Hello World"')
- For targeted edits, say 'change nothing else' and mention what should stay the same
- Describe what you want the result to look like, not the editing operation

Prompting tips:
- Be precise and verbatim when describing desired changes (e.g. 'change the text to say "Hello World"')
- For targeted edits, say 'change nothing else' and mention what should stay the same
- Describe what you want the result to look like, not the editing operation

image.description: An image id, or a public https URL.

specs.name: request_upload

tools.description:
This tool generates realistic/general-purpose images via ComfyUI.
Use natural language to describe the image you want. Be specific about composition, lighting, style, and subject.

Examples:
- A photorealistic portrait of an elderly man with weathered skin, dramatic side lighting
- A cozy coffee shop interior with warm morning light streaming through windows, watercolor style
- A futuristic cityscape at sunset with flying vehicles, cinematic wide shot

Note: The first generation after launching ComfyUI may take 1-2 minutes while the model loads into GPU memory. If the request times out, please retry.

The aspect_ratio parameter controls image shape: square (1:1), portrait (3:4), landscape (4:3), tall (9:16), wide (16:9). Default is square.

IMPORTANT: The generated image may not appear inline in the conversation, but it IS sent to the user. Do not assume the generation failed just because you cannot see the image.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description:
Edit an image using a text prompt. `image` is an image id or a public https URL. Every image these tools return comes with its image id, and request_upload returns one for an image the user attached.

To edit an image the user attached to the chat, call request_upload with its filename, run the code it returns in your code execution environment, and pass the image id it prints. If code execution is unavailable, ask the user to enable it (Settings > Capabilities > Code execution and file creation) or to give a public URL.

Optionally pass a second image as reference material. When using two images, refer to them as 'image1' and 'image2' in the prompt.

The output keeps the size and aspect ratio of the FIRST image (image1): it comes back at the resolution it went in at, unless it is very large, in which case it is scaled down to fit the model's budget. The second image only serves as reference material. So when combining images (e.g. putting image2's subject into image1's scene), pass the one whose framing should be kept first.

Prompting tips:
- Be precise and verbatim when describing desired changes (e.g. 'change the text to say "Hello World"')
- For targeted edits, say 'change nothing else' and mention what should stay the same
- Describe what you want the result to look like, not the editing operation

image.description: An image id, or a public https URL.

second_image.description: Optional second image id or https URL.

tools.name: request_upload
tools.description: Get a one-time upload link for an image the user attached to the chat, so edit_image can use it. Returns Python code to run in your code execution environment; it uploads the file and prints the image id to pass to edit_image. The link expires after 10 minutes, so call this right before the edit.

filename.description: Name of the attached file, as it appears in your code execution environment.
